images.author: Paul Fernandez
images.why: Explicitly captioned full-body Cape buffalo; photographed in the unfenced Ngala/Kruger ecosystem. Strong framing candidate. Linked size is a lower-resolution fallback; original availability was not verified.

images.author: Kathy Karn
images.why: Standing Cape buffalo in open African habitat, with substantial body coverage and a clear horn silhouette. Photographer identifies the species; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: Andrew Field
images.why: Lone buffalo with an uncluttered natural setting and strong body silhouette. Photographer explicitly identifies Syncerus caffer caffer and supplies camera settings; original dimensions unverified.

images.author: Bernard DUPONT
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies a Cape buffalo bull, Syncerus caffer, at Sable Dam in Kruger National Park. Freely licensed wild-animal option; linked size is below the preferred 2000 pixels.

images.author: G N
images.why: 4558 × 3128 photograph, identified as African/Cape buffalo and tagged bull and Tanzania. Green grass and prominent horns; closer framing than the requested full-body view.

images.author: Fali Poncha
images.why: 4009 × 3757, already near-square for a 9:10 crop. Source identifies African buffalo/Syncerus caffer in savanna; strong horn detail, but a close-up rather than full-body composition.

images.author: Elize Bezuidenhout
images.why: 3587 × 2303 African buffalo photograph with oxpeckers in natural habitat. Detailed wildlife alternative with additional visual interest; tight framing limits full-body use.

images.author: Josef Spang
images.why: 6000 × 4000 African buffalo portrait explicitly located in Lumo, Kenya. Ample resolution for cropping; a portrait fallback rather than the preferred full-body savanna view.

images.author: Christoph Moning
images.why: Dark-coated banteng standing in grassland, with pale stockings and clear horns; associated with the Bos javanicus species page. Original iNaturalist file. Observation research-grade status could not be verified.

images.author: Trevor Ellery
images.why: Caption identifies banteng; the accompanying Java trip report documents wild Bos javanicus at Alas Purwo. Promising original photographer source; sex, dimensions and final crop suitability were not independently verified.

images.author: Wade Strickland
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies banteng at Alas Purwo National Park, East Java. Native wild setting confirmed by caption; bull characteristics require visual confirmation, and linked resolution is below the preference.

images.author: K Fletcher & D Baylis / Wildside Photography
images.why: Explicitly captioned Bos javanicus bull leading a herd through Mondulkiri Protected Forest, Cambodia. Particularly strong geographic verification; linked resolution is below preference, and watermark status was not visually verified.

images.author: Tontan Travel
images.why: Explicitly identified wild Bos javanicus bull in Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuary, Thailand. Freely licensed male alternative; dark-coat suitability and larger-file availability were not verified.

images.author: Dáni Balla
images.why: Caption-confirmed banteng grazing at Alas Purwo with green peafowl. Attractive grassland context; competing animals make it a weaker single-animal poster option. Sex and pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: K Fletcher & D Baylis / Wildside Photography
images.why: Caption confirms a young Bos javanicus bull leading cows through wild Cambodian forest. Age compromise versus the requested mature bull; lower-resolution fallback, with watermark status not visually verified.

images.author: K Fletcher & D Baylis / Wildside Photography
images.why: Alternative frame of the caption-confirmed young banteng bull in Mondulkiri Protected Forest. Authentic native habitat, but a weaker age match and similar to the preceding candidate; resolution and watermark limitations remain.
